title: SkillLayer

sourceId.description: A skill source's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adds the source, kept in lowercase.

oneOf.description: The environment's own skills directory, or its commands directory.

root.description: The repository root the member lies under: .claude/skills before .agents/skills, then .claude/commands.

directory.description: The directory holding that root, from the repository's root: the workspace directory or one of its parents, . for the repository's root; a nearer one wins a name.

description: The layer a member lies in: a source, the own directory, or a trusted repository's .claude/skills or .agents/skills.
